title: Vercel hero
description: A calm, airy monochrome hero as tall as the window: a two-line 64px tight title and two pill buttons on the left, a large artwork slot centred behind everything, three short lines in a narrow right column, and a row of customer wordmarks spread along the bottom. On phones the artwork sits on top, the title and buttons centre and stack, the three lines become one mono line that cycles through them with a quick fade, and the wordmarks run as a slow marquee.
notes: desktop height follows the window (100svh minus the 64px header); phones size to content
the artwork slot is 1080×720 on desktop and 390×400 on phones; empty, it shows a soft grey haze
CSS only: the phone line cycle and the marquee are keyframes, off with reduced motion
